correctness.rationale: For C=span{u,v}, words with zero u-coefficient have weight d, while every word with nonzero u-coefficient has at least 2d+1-ceil(d/(q-1))=d+t+1 nonzero coordinates. Full-weight multiples of u remain, and k=n-2d+1=2, so the same-form mirror conclusion fails. The exact enumerator and edge cases were independently recomputed within the review, with supplementary exhaustive checks over several prime fields.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 17 September 2026 source proves the binary theorem and discusses why its proof is binary-specific, but its MDS discussion does not satisfy the theorem's gap premise. Searches found no prior all-q>2 family satisfying the literal hypotheses while violating the conclusion. The elementary underlying code is not claimed as independently new; older catalogues and near-simultaneous responses remain residual risks.

value.rationale: The family supplies a genuine hypothesis-satisfying nonbinary counterexample, works over every q>2 and every d>=2, permits unbounded local-gap width for fixed q, and cleanly isolates the cancellation mechanism separating binary from nonbinary alphabets.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
